valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 24 Nov 2026. (1) Business: a holding company; its value is mostly its listed stakes, weighted by market value (CSE closes 23 Nov 2026; Melstacorp's own cash and property left in 'other'): Distilleries 4,248.26mn shares × Rs 58.00 = Rs 246.4bn (69%); Aitken Spence 208.41mn × Rs 150.00 = Rs 31.3bn (9%); John Keells 1,418.09mn × Rs 18.40 = Rs 26.1bn (7%); Commercial Bank and DFCC about Rs 17.4bn (5%); Lanka Milk Foods 130.36mn × Rs 84.10 = Rs 11.0bn (3%); other (plantations, Browns Beach, unlisted subsidiaries, investment property) about Rs 25bn (7%). (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) could NOT be opened: pages.stern.nyu.edu is blocked by this run's network settings. Stand-ins: Beverage (Alcoholic) unlevered, cash-corrected 0.63 (web-search extract of a Damodaran table, 14 firms; market label unconfirmed); Aitken Spence at this site's SPEN beta 0.94; John Keells and 'other' at the same diversified 0.94; banks at the money-centre bank beta 0.70 (as for SAMP); Lanka Milk Foods (food) at 0.63, as for BFL. (3) Distilleries has no net debt to speak of (Rs 1.0bn of borrowings against more cash), so its beta isn't relevered; the holding company's own net debt is about Rs 3.9bn of overdraft against a Rs 200bn+ equity value, so no relevering at that level. Weighted: 0.69 × 0.63 + 0.09 × 0.94 + 0.07 × 0.94 + 0.05 × 0.70 + 0.03 × 0.63 + 0.07 × 0.94 = 0.70. (4) Local 5-year betas: none could be checked (stockanalysis.com blocked; web search gave no dated 5-year figure). Step 4 can't be completed. (5) 0.70. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's file and three local 5-year betas.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (24 Nov 2026, price Rs 185 given): cost of debt 5.72% (interest paid 5.33 ÷ average borrowings and leases, FY 2026; low because about two-thirds of term loans are US-dollar SOFR loans, note 31.3), tax 44.5% (FY 2026 effective), debt weight 27.3% (net debt Rs 80.87bn at Sep 2026). For reference only: no whole-company DCF.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: Sum of the parts, P/E, justified P/B, residual income, dividend model
valuationInputs.reason: Holding company: Distilleries and Aitken Spence are valued in their own analyses (with DCFs), and minorities own about a third of group equity (Rs 74.1bn of Rs 235.6bn, Sep 2026), so no whole-company DCF. Dividend model included: payout about 48% (FY 2026 company figure 48.25%), paid from Rs 13.24bn of dividends received.

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 3% / 4% / 5%; supported −0.3% (reinvestment rate −2.6% × return on capital 12.6%, FY 2026); 5.7% on profit kept 51.7% × ROE 11.0%
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py. All three more than 2 points above the reinvestment-based rate: kept because FY 2026 reinvestment was held down by Rs 2.1bn of working capital released, while H1 FY2027 capex reached Rs 9.27bn (Rs 4.59bn a year earlier), including the BMW premises (Rs 2.68bn, AR p. 183) and the Seeduwa bottling plant (about Rs 1.3bn). All within the 5.7% retention-based rate and below the 12.24% bond yield. Used as long-run growth and the dividend model's five-year growth.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE
valuationInputs.reason: Owners' ROE 13.6% in FY 2026 (19.69 on average equity 144.7) and 12.1% over the 12 months to Sep 2026 (derived.py); company's own figure 10.98% / 11.41%. Residual income starts at 12.1%.

valuationInputs.name: EPS to March 2027
valuationInputs.reason: H1 EPS Rs 7.24; H2 Rs 6.8 / 8.4 / 9.8 against Rs 8.94 in H2 FY 2026 (which included discontinued Rs 0.87 for the year; tourism earns in H2). Base 3.6% below the Rs 16.18 run-rate; bear 13.5% below because Q2 (Rs 2.63, tax 61% of profit) annualises to Rs 10.52.

valuationInputs.name: Payout
valuationInputs.reason: FY 2026 dividend payout 48.25% (AR p. 4); Rs 8.15 on EPS Rs 16.89.

valuationInputs.name: Restructuring tax deduction
valuationInputs.reason: Company Rs 17.1bn plus 92.35% of Distilleries' Rs 6.1bn (group Rs 23.2bn less company Rs 17.1bn), interim note 8. Court of Appeal dismissed the writs on 9 Oct 2026; Supreme Court appeal pending; directors expect no liability on legal advice. No basis to judge the odds, so the base takes half.

valuationInputs.name: Holding-company discount
valuationInputs.reason: Control by Milford Exports and Lanka Milk Foods (58.5% not public), cross-holdings (Lanka Milk Foods owns 13% of Melstacorp and Melstacorp owns Lanka Milk Foods shares), and holding costs; the market itself prices about a 40% discount to the parts at market.

valuationInputs.name: Maintenance capex basis
valuationInputs.reason: No company split; scripts/reinvestment.py range Rs 9.63 / 8.50 / 8.33bn (depreciation Rs 8.53bn). Capex FY 2026 mostly upkeep plus about Rs 1.3bn named growth (Seeduwa).

Sum of the parts using this site's DIST and SPEN values, less half the disputed Rs 22.7bn restructuring tax and a 10% holding discount (base Rs 176.5), alongside P/E, justified P/B, residual income and a dividend model at a 15.4% cost of equity (beta 0.70, provisional). 3 of 4 business tests (fails ROE): category 2, watch list. Price Rs 185.00 is the 30 Sep 2026 last trade (CSE not reachable from this run).
